source: Forecast constants of a Kimi-K2.6 TP4 step model fitted on one GB300 run (6P3D, concurrency 128, prefill workers 0-5, fit window 300-1800 s); forecast with the next-pass lag: APE mean 13.5 %, p50 6.7 %, p95 36.8 % on its score window
units: gpu coefficients in ms over [1, new tokens, attention pairs / 1e6, host tokens, batch size]
notes: 'large' only: all busy passes are full ~8k chunks; 'small' (<= 2048 new tokens) is not identified
new_tokens coefficient 0: full chunks make it collinear with the intercept
LAUNCH_Y_MAX_S = 5 s (a forecast constant) drops launch intervals >= 5 s: share 0.102 of the fit-window Kimi intervals; raise it (e.g. 15 s) before any online launch refit on Kimi
The online GPU fit needs idle single-request passes; a saturated Kimi P has few (see idle counts): freeze these warmup constants instead of relying on the online refit
